data.description: Masdar City: Pioneering Sustainable Urban Living in the Heart of Abu Dhabi.

data.answer: Masdar City offers a unique and sustainable lifestyle in Abu Dhabi, seamlessly blending modern living with environmental responsibility. The city relies entirely on renewable energy, especially solar power, and features energy-efficient buildings and green spaces. Residents have diverse housing options equipped with smart technologies to monitor and reduce energy consumption. As a hub for clean technology and innovation, Masdar City hosts numerous companies and the Masdar Institute of Science and Technology. Its pedestrian-friendly design encourages walking and cycling, promoting a healthy lifestyle. With excellent connectivity to major attractions and Abu Dhabi International Airport, Masdar City provides a forward-thinking environment that supports both personal and professional growth in a clean, green, and innovative setting.

Properties in Masdar City, Abu Dhabi include apartments, penthouses, and townhouses, all offering modern amenities and upgraded living. The apartments, designed with a contemporary outlook, range from studios to 1 to 4-bedroom units. Townhouses, integrated within apartment complexes, are also available.

These residences combine traditional Arabic architecture with modern technology and come equipped with built-in wardrobes, kitchen appliances, and spacious balconies. Residents enjoy convenient facilities such as covered car parking, shared gyms, and swimming pools within the apartment complexes.

Most Popular Buildings in Masdar City

Masdar City boasts several popular residential buildings that exemplify its sustainable and eco-friendly ethos. The Leonardo Residences offer modern apartments with energy-efficient designs, smart home technologies, and access to green spaces. The Al Maha Arjaan by Rotana provides luxurious living with amenities such as a rooftop swimming pool and fitness center, all while adhering to sustainable building practices.

The Oasis Residences, known for their contemporary design and spacious layouts, integrate solar panels and innovative cooling systems to reduce energy consumption. These residential buildings, along with others in Masdar City, provide residents with a high-quality, environmentally conscious lifestyle in a vibrant and forward-thinking community.

Upcoming Buildings in Masdar City

Masdar City Abu Dhabi is rapidly expanding, with numerous upcoming buildings enhancing the community's appeal. Here are the two off plan properties in the area:

Royal Park
Royal Park at Masdar City, Abu Dhabi, is an expansive residential development by Reportage Properties. It offers 1, 2, and 4-bedroom apartments, as well as four-bedroom penthouses and townhouses.

Reportage Plaza
It is the newest sustainable residential development in Masdar City, offering stylishly designed studios, 1 & 2-bedroom apartments, and 4-bedroom townhouses in Abu Dhabi.

Rental Trends in Masdar City

In Masdar City, the annual rent for a studio unit starts at AED 39k, while renting a 1-bedroom unit starts at a minimum of AED 80k per year. For those seeking larger spaces, the average annual rent for a 2-bedroom flat is AED 55k, and a 3-bedroom apartment costs about AED 120k per year. You can also consider penthouses and townhouses in the area available for rent if you need a bigger space. If you are looking for more rental options in the capital or the neighbouring city, consult with the rental experts in Dubai.

Sale Trends in Masdar City

Various properties for sale are available in Masdar City, including apartments, penthouses, and townhouses. The sale price of a 1-bedroom flat in Masdar City begins at AED 435k, while the starting sale price for a 2-bedroom apartment is AED 700k. For those interested in larger units, the minimum cost of purchasing a 3-bedroom unit is AED 871k, while prices for 4-bedroom apartments start at AED 1.06M. more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Masdar City Abu Dhabi?

data.answer:
Living in Masdar City offers a unique blend of modern comfort and sustainable living. Designed to be a model of urban sustainability, the city is powered entirely by renewable energy sources, primarily solar power. This commitment to green living is reflected in the energy-efficient buildings, abundant green spaces, and innovative cooling systems that keep the environment comfortable while minimizing energy use.

Public Transportation in Masdar City

Masdar City offers efficient and sustainable public transportation options to its residents and visitors. Masdar City transportation includes a network of electric buses and a personal rapid transit (PRT) system that uses automated, driverless vehicles. These options ensure easy and eco-friendly commuting within the city, reducing reliance on traditional fuel-based transport and minimizing the community's carbon footprint. Additionally, the city's strategic location near Abu Dhabi International Airport provides convenient connectivity for longer journeys.

Supermarkets in Masdar City

Residents of Masdar City have access to several supermarkets that cater to their daily shopping needs, such as F-Mart Supermarket, Grandiose, Carrefour, and Sunlight Supermarket. These supermarkets offer a wide range of products, including fresh produce, groceries, household items, and more. Conveniently located within the community, they provide an essential service, ensuring that residents can easily purchase their everyday necessities without needing to travel far.

Shopping Malls Near Masdar City

My City Centre Masdar, the leisure and shopping hub in the heart of Masdar City in Abu Dhabi, is designed to feature over 70 stores on an 18,500-square-meter site.

For a more extensive shopping experience, residents of Masdar City can visit nearby malls such as Yas Mall and Abu Dhabi Mall. These shopping centers offer a diverse array of retail outlets, from international brands to local boutiques, along with a variety of dining and entertainment options. The proximity of these malls provides residents with convenient access to a broader shopping and leisure experience, enhancing the overall quality of life in Masdar City.

Schools and Nurseries in Masdar City

Masdar City is home to several schools and nurseries, providing quality educational options for families living in the community. Masdar City is home to a campus of the Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence. Parents with young children can enroll them at Blossom Nursery, also located within Masdar City. For school-aged children, Ryan International School offers education following the International CBSE curriculum, featuring state-of-the-art infrastructure, modern classrooms, a swimming pool, an auditorium, and activity rooms.

Additionally, residents have access to top-rated schools and nurseries in the neighboring Khalifa City, providing further educational options.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Masdar City

Masdar City offers convenient access to various places of worship, catering to the diverse religious needs of its residents. The community features several mosques within its vicinity, providing residents with easy access to prayer facilities. For those seeking churches, the St. Joseph's Cathedral in Abu Dhabi is approximately a 25-minute drive away. Hindu residents can visit the BAPS Hindu Mandir, currently under construction in Abu Dhabi, which is about a 30-minute drive from Masdar City.

Hospitals and Clinics in Masdar City

Masdar City is well-equipped with healthcare facilities to cater to the needs of its residents. Within the city, there are several clinics providing general medical services and specialist care. For more comprehensive medical treatment, residents can visit nearby hospitals such as NMC Royal Hospital in Khalifa City, which is about a 10-minute drive away, and Burjeel Medical City, located approximately 15 minutes away. These facilities ensure that residents have access to quality healthcare services within a short distance from their homes.

Masdar City Abu Dhabi Location & Nearby Areas

Masdar City is strategically located in Abu Dhabi, approximately 17 kilometers southeast of the city center and adjacent to Abu Dhabi International Airport. This prime location offers residents easy access to major attractions such as Yas Island and Ferrari World, which are about a 15-minute drive away.

The city is also close to well-established residential areas like Khalifa City and Al Raha Beach, providing a blend of convenience and connectivity. With major roads like Al Khaleej Al Arabi Street and Al Shahama Road (E10) nearby, Masdar City is well-connected to the rest of Abu Dhabi, making it an ideal place for modern, sustainable living.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Masdar City

data.answer:
Masdar City offers a variety of activities and attractions for residents and visitors. You can explore the sustainable urban landscape with walking and cycling paths, visit the Eco-Villa for a demonstration of sustainable living, or enjoy the green spaces and parks throughout the community. The Masdar Institute campus and Masdar Park provide educational and recreational opportunities. Additionally, the city frequently hosts community events, workshops, and markets that promote eco-friendly practices and foster a vibrant community spirit.

Masdar City Restaurants & Bars

Masdar City features an array of dining options that cater to diverse tastes. You can find a selection of Masdar City restaurants offering international cuisines, from Middle Eastern and Asian to European dishes. Kabab Ji, McDonald's, Pizza Hut, and Zaatar w Zeit in My City Centre Masdar are the popular dining options in the area. Other Masdar City Abu Dhabi restaurants are Marl's Organic and Skinny Joe The Healthy Cafe.

While the city focuses more on family-friendly dining experiences, nearby areas like Yas Island offer a wider range of bars and nightlife options for those looking to unwind and socialize in the evenings.

Beaches Near Masdar City

Residents of Masdar City can easily access several beautiful beaches located a short drive away. Yas Beach, situated on Yas Island, is about a 15-minute drive and offers a relaxing beachfront with water sports and dining facilities. Saadiyat Beach, known for its pristine sands and clear waters, is approximately a 25-minute drive from Masdar City. These beaches provide perfect spots for relaxation, swimming, and enjoying the coastal scenery of Abu Dhabi.

Hotels in Masdar City

Masdar City has several hotels that provide comfortable and eco-friendly accommodations. Notable options include the Hilton Abu Dhabi Yas Island, which is a short drive away, and the Premier Inn Abu Dhabi International Airport Hotel, located conveniently close to the city. These hotels offer modern amenities, sustainable practices, and easy access to both Masdar City and nearby attractions, making them ideal for both business and leisure travelers.

Attractions and Landmarks in and Near Masdar City

Masdar City and its surrounding areas boast a variety of attractions and landmarks. Within the city, you can visit the futuristic Masdar Institute and explore its innovative sustainable technologies. Nearby, Yas Island offers exciting attractions such as Ferrari World, Yas Waterworld, and Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi, all within a 15-minute drive. The Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, a stunning architectural marvel, is about a 20-minute drive from Masdar City. These landmarks and attractions provide residents and visitors with a mix of educational, recreational, and cultural experiences.

While the city is designed with sustainability and modern living in mind, it may lack the extensive range of restaurants, shopping centers, and nightlife that can be found in other parts of the city. |However, residents can easily travel to nearby areas such as Yas Island or central Abu Dhabi to access a broader variety of dining, shopping, and entertainment venues.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness Centers  and Salons

Masdar City offers a variety of outdoor activities, fitness centers, and salons to cater to the lifestyle needs of its residents. The city features numerous parks and green spaces, providing ample opportunities for walking, jogging, and cycling in a pleasant, eco-friendly environment.

For those seeking private gyms, Pilatiq Fitness Studio is available within Masdar City. Residents also have access to numerous parlors and salons for personal grooming. Within the community, you can find Nails The Modern Manicure Studio and Styles & Smiles Ladies Beauty Salon. For gentlemen, CT Style Salon and Pochinki Salon offer grooming services.

What types of housing are available in Masdar City?

Masdar City offers a variety of housing options, including studios, 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, penthouses, and townhouses. These residences are designed with modern amenities and sustainable features, such as smart home technologies and energy-efficient designs, to promote eco-friendly living.

What amenities and facilities are available in Masdar City?

Residents of Masdar City have access to a range of amenities, including supermarkets, fitness centers, parks, and recreational facilities. The city also features several restaurants and cafes, educational institutions like the Masdar Institute of Science and Technology, and healthcare services. Additionally, the city hosts various community events and markets promoting sustainability.

What makes Masdar City a sustainable community?

Masdar City is built with sustainability at its core. It uses renewable energy sources, primarily solar power, and features energy-efficient buildings designed to reduce energy consumption.

The city incorporates green building practices, extensive green spaces, and innovative cooling systems. Additionally, the community promotes eco-friendly practices such as recycling and the use of electric vehicles, making it a model for sustainable urban living.

Where is Masdar City located?

Masdar City is located in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It is situated approximately 17 kilometers southeast of the city center and is adjacent to Abu Dhabi International Airport.

data.content:
Masdar City is a mixed-use development in Abu Dhabi, created by Masdar. Established in 2006, it is designed to evolve into a sustainable urban community. The community is envisioned to accommodate around 50,000 residents and 1,500 companies specializing in environmentally friendly products.

The planned community relies entirely on solar energy and maximizes the use of renewable energy for its operations, promoting a clean and healthy environment. It is one of the top sustainability initiatives in the UAE, striving for carbon neutrality and zero waste.

Masdar City is adjacent to the airport and close to the major leisure attractions of Yas Island. It also borders the well-established residential area of Khalifa City. The area boasts excellent road connectivity, with Al Khaleej Al Arabi Street, Al Rawafid Street, and Al Ishoush Street providing direct access to Abu Dhabi Al Shahama Road (E10).

nodes.title: Oasis 1

These exceptionally designed apartments feature a limited number of two-level duplexes showcasing an innovative design-the first of its kind residential development in Abu Dhabi region. Quality insulations are used together with high thermal resistance glass and the finishing materials International aluminium cladding in various harmonised grey colours and the balconies are made with tempered security glass providing seamless views to the scenic surrounding.

While its communal ground level features landscaped recreational areas with a swimming pool, gymnasium, kids play areas and barbecue areas. Each unit has their own private terrace or balconies and fully equipped kitchen.

nodes.title: Royal Park
nodes.about:
Royal Park by Reportage Properties is a modern residential complex consisting of 6 mid-rise buildings. The buildings have a modern architectural design and are located in the unique Masdar City community in the UAE, built according to green building principles.

The complex features 1, 2 and 4 bedroom apartments, as well as three-storey townhouses and duplex penthouses.

Each Royal Park apartment and penthouse is decorated with stylish and functional finishes using high quality materials. All properties are equipped with balconies, master bedrooms with bathrooms and dressing rooms. Townhouses are planned with an elevator installation location. Included in the price are kitchen cabinets and countertops, built-ins with plumbing fixtures, bathrooms and central air conditioning.

Royal Park residents have access to a variety of amenities such as an outdoor pool, fitness center and children's playground. The complex is located in a developed employment area, including a park, an international school, an artificial intelligence university, a shopping center and public transport links. Important landmarks such as Masdar City Central Park, Mohamed Bin Zayed University for Artificial Intelligence and Masdar Solar Photovoltaic Farm are within a series connection from the complex.

nodes.title: Plaza
nodes.about: Plaza is one of the most sustainable local projects that brings together a modern approach to architecture and living. The residential complex received 3 pearls in the rating of sustainable development and fits into the futuristic vision of Abu Dhabi development. The project was created according to environmentally friendly principles and has a functional design, where every detail is made with exceptional taste and based on modern technologies. The Plaza covers an area of over 10,000 sq. m and includes many residential apartments and townhouses with a full range of amenities. The location gives the complex an investment potential, as it is located in a beautiful area of Masdar City close to major highways and close to parks, schools, mosques, banks and shops. Plaza is an innovative complex that consumes little energy without losing the characteristics that make it elite.

nodes.title: Al Mahra Residence
nodes.about:
Al Mahra Residence is a project of the Siadah development company from Abu Dhabi. This residential complex includes two 8-storey buildings and offers 300 residential units, including studios and apartments with 1-2 bedrooms, as well as duplexes with 1 and 3 bedrooms. The exterior of the buildings impresses with modern design and functionality. Each unit is equipped with private pools and spacious terraces providing natural shade and light.

At Al Mahra Residence, residents can enjoy a central air conditioning system, a video surveillance system, covered parking, a children's playground, a gym, an indoor pool and a public courtyard.

Mediclinic Khalifa City and Amana Healthcare Medical and Rehabilitation Hospital are located next to the complex, and Ryan International School (CBSE) can be reached in 20 minutes. Masdar Phase 2 Retail Plaza and My City Centre Masdar Shopping Malls are a 10-minute walk away, while Al Raha Mall is a 20-minute drive away. There are also beauty salons, shops, a pharmacy LIFE Pharmacy and various restaurants and cafes nearby.

Al Mahra Residence is favorably located near Abu Dhabi International Airport and major thoroughfares, providing convenient transport accessibility. Attractions such as Yas Island and Saadiyat Island are 20-30 minutes away, making life at Al Mahra Residence surprisingly convenient and comfortable.
